indicator_name: International migration of the CIS countries (CIS Stat): arrivals, departures, net; by CIS partner from 2016
description: Международная миграция стран СНГ (Статкомитет СНГ): прибывшие, выбывшие, сальдо; по странам СНГ с 2016 г.
geography: CIS and former-USSR countries (CIS Stat); region = ISO3 of the reporting country
methodology: CIS Stat facts 4650866 / 4679599 («Прибывшие/Выбывшие по потокам», persons; items ARRIVALS, DEPARTURES = «Международная миграция - всего», ARRIVALS.CIS / .NON_CIS and DEPARTURES.CIS / .NON_CIS where given) and 44243 / 44245 (by partner country, «Тип местности» = «Всего»; items ARRIVALS.<ISO3>, DEPARTURES.<ISO3>, 2016 onward, the reporting country's own row included). NET = ARRIVALS - DEPARTURES, computed here (transformation «arrivals minus departures»); the committee's own net fact 5320380 is not used (Kazakhstan 2016: -20 193 against 13 755 - 34 900 = -21 145). Kazakhstan 1991-1999: arrivals 170 787, 161 499, 111 082, 70 389, 71 137, 53 874, 38 067, 40 624, 41 320; departures 228 473, 317 760, 330 107, 477 068, 309 632, 229 412, 299 455, 243 663, 164 947. Equal to BNS MIGRATION_ARRIVALS / MIGRATION_DEPARTURES in 2000-2025 except 2008 (CIS Stat 46 404 / 45 287, BNS 46 113 / 44 813). «Неизвестно» and internal moves are not kept (the answer repeats them under a parent it does not show). No Turkmenistan as reporter. CIS Stat last updated 2026-09-17.
